title.en: An Act to Advance the Opening of the Second Regular Session of the Philippine Legislature.

text.en:
Any provision of existing law to the contrary notwithstanding, the Second Regular Session of the
Philippine Legislature shall begin on Monday, June twenty-fourth, nineteen hundred and thirty-five.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, June 20, 1935.
